name: Breakfast Burrito
steps: Smear a quarter of an avocado on the tortilla wrap.
Add sriracha, salt, and pepper to taste.
Cook the fries in the air fryer at 150°C for 10 minutes.
Scramble 2 eggs per wrap and spread them on top of the avocado.
Cut the lettuce and leeks and add them to the wrap.
Add the fries on top of the vegetables.
Add cheese on top of the fries.
Fold the tortilla into a wrap and enjoy.
